html:
SMTO-CFG-0100 — SMTO couldn't start work from this plan

GUID: 03287071-29de-5c98-b456-d5d989fc6a37
Slug: plan-transition
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: collaboration

What happened

  • You chose to carry out a plan, but that plan changed, is still being written, was deleted, or was already started another way. SMTO didn't start a second copy of the work.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the page and open the conversation. Look for Implementation accepted on the plan card, a task called Implement the plan, or a new conversation named Implement plan. The plan may already be running from an earlier click or another device.
  2. If nothing started and the plan is still being written, wait until it finishes and the Implement this plan? card appears. Only a finished plan can be carried out.
  3. If the plan or your conversation options changed, use the newest plan card and select Yes, implement this plan or Yes, clear context and implement. SMTO only carries out the exact plan version you are looking at.
  4. If the plan's conversation was deleted, choose Plan in the Agent mode menu and ask for a new plan. A deleted plan can't be carried out.

What success looks like

  • The plan card shows Implementation accepted, and exactly one implementation task appears.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep pressing the buttons on an old plan card. The text of a queued Implement the plan task can't be edited; ask for a revised plan instead.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Plan implementation was refused: the source plan is missing or deleted, not finalized in Plan mode, its digest no longer matches expected_plan_digest, or the card was already consumed or the conversation's composer profile changed (plan_missing, plan_not_final, plan_stale or plan_conflict).

What this means

  • Plan implementation cannot resolve the eligible saved source, detects noncanonical/stale digest or wrong mode, or finds an already consumed/changed implementation binding. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • Plan implementation cannot resolve the eligible saved source, detects noncanonical/stale digest or wrong mode, or finds an already consumed/changed implementation binding.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare server-owned source identity, plan digest and existing implementation submission; client text is not authoritative plan input.

How to fix it

  • Read the plan's current state through the plans route under /api/agent/chats/.../plans/... to compare the proposed_plan digest and any recorded implementation. Reload the client and submit the current digest with a new client_submission_id only if no implementation exists. Prompt edits to queued tasks that carry an approved plan are rejected by design.
  • Refresh the saved plan and inspect any existing implementation task before submitting its supported implementation action.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended retained plan and one accepted implementation binding agree.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
